title: Horrendous
body:
Not worth the money. 
If you need this app to connect with your Samsung watch good luck. 

I hope my issue is with the watch rather than the app but the watch requires this app and it really does not work. I have a Samsung Gear Fit 2 Pro and the sequence required to sync involves three apps and must be done in the correct order. Most days I have to restart both phone and watch and despite showing as connected in a couple of places (Bluetooth settings and Samsung Gear app) most days this app says there are no wearable devices connected. So I can rarely download data and when it does work I get two days max of data losing the rest. It’s a celebration when it does download. 

I’ve contacted the support team and the response is slow, and really demonstrated that the developer needs to rethink the experience for users - eg the need to open the Samsung Gear app and then the Samsung Health app (but not by using the Samsung Health icon in the Gear app as that doesn’t work). 

I won’t start on the watch that is a whole other basket case of issues definitely no good if you want reliable GPS or sleep data. It’s so wrong it is laughable. 150 kilometers in 20 minutes of exercise?
